title: Stock check
passage: Are there any replacement filters in the storeroom? A. The room was repainted last week. B. I used the last one yesterday. C. Replace them every six months.
passageZh:
儲藏室裡有替換濾網嗎？
A. 房間上週重新油漆了。
B. 我昨天用掉最後一個了。
C. 每六個月更換一次。
audioScript: Are there any replacement filters in the storeroom? A. The room was repainted last week. B. I used the last one yesterday. C. Replace them every six months.
